lookFor: analyze_sentiment=true in a Deepgram request, as a query string or an option

entries.what: summarize=v1 returns HTTP 400, and the V1 response structure is gone. summarize=true stays live and returns the V2 structure.

source.quote: As of today, requests using these legacy parameters will return HTTP 400 errors.

lookFor: summarize=v1 in a Deepgram request, as a query string or an option
entries.replacement: summarize=true or summarize=v2, which both return the V2 structure.
requires: Response parsing changes too: V2 returns a single summary object across all channels with result and short, where V1 returned a summaries array with summary, start_word and end_word per channel. Code that sends summarize=true and reads the V1 shape needs this as well, and no matcher finds it.

entries.what: The Voice Agent model gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview is removed. The page prints May 26, 2025 in a changelog entry dated May 19, 2026, so this reads the year as 2026.

source.quote: gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview is deprecated and will be removed on May 26, 2025. Migrate to gemini-3.1-flash-lite.

lookFor: The model id gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview in a Deepgram Voice Agent think provider

entries.what: The dg-token header no longer verifies that a callback came from Deepgram. A callback server that requires it can start rejecting real callbacks.

source.quote: The dg-token header is no longer a supported method to verify that callback requests come from Deepgram. If your callback server checks for dg-token, switch to Basic Auth.

lookFor: A callback handler that reads the dg-token header
entries.replacement: Basic Auth, with credentials in the callback URL. Speech-to-Text can also use a secret passed with Extra Metadata.
requires: Both sides change: the callback URL sent to Deepgram gains credentials, and the callback server checks them instead of the header.
